:::{#lem-cross-term-zero}
#### The conditional mean's error is uncorrelated with any function of the input

Let $\bestpredfnf{\Predvar} \eqdef \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}$.
For any prediction function $\predfnf{\Predvar}$ with $\E{\predfnf{\Predvar}^2} < \infty$:

$$\E{\prederr_{\bestpredfn} \cd \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}}} = 0$$

:::

::: proof

Because $\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}$ is a function of $\Predvar$,
by @thm-cond-pull-out it factors out of the conditional expectation:

$$
\ba
\E{\prederr_{\bestpredfn}\paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}} \mid \Predvar}
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}} \cd \E{\prederr_{\bestpredfn} \mid \Predvar}
&& \text{(a function of } \Predvar \text{ factors out)} \\
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}} \cd \E{\bestpredfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar \mid \Predvar}
&& \text{(definition of } \prederr_{\bestpredfn} \text{)} \\
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}} \cd \paren{\E{\bestpredfnf{\Predvar} \mid \Predvar} - \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(linearity of conditional expectation)} \\
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}} \cd \paren{\bestpredfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(a function of } \Predvar \text{ is its own conditional mean, and definition of } \bestpredfnf{\Predvar} \text{)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{(evaluate)}
\ea
$$

By the law of iterated expectations (@thm-lie):

$$
\ba
\E{\prederr_{\bestpredfn}\paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}}}
&= \E{\E{\prederr_{\bestpredfn}\paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}} \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(law of iterated expectations)} \\
&= \E{0}
&& \text{(the conditional expectation is } 0 \text{)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{(expectation of a constant)}
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-cross-term-zero}
#### The vanishing cross term in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor, take $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$.
When $\Predvar = 0$, $\bestpredfnf{0} = 1$, so $\predfn_1\paren{0} - \bestpredfnf{0} = 2$,
and $\prederr_{\bestpredfn} = 1 - \Outvar$ is $1$ or $-1$ with equal probability,
so the product has conditional mean $0$.
The same cancellation happens when $\Predvar = 1$,
so the expectation of the product is $0$.

:::
